title: Build the iHRIS 5 IG with fhir-harness
description: Builds the iHRIS 5 IG from the source src/ihris5/ihris5.json pins: mounts it, applies the declared patches to a workspace copy, runs one IG Publisher build through litlfred/fhir-ig-publisher's ast-export (pinned), derives the artefact index and menu (fhir-harness ast-to-artifact-index, ingest-ig-menu), writes the artefact pages (gen-ig-pages) and composes them with the IG's own narrative (stage-ig-sites) into the platform chrome scoped to ihris (compose-docs --shell, gen-navbar-include), built with just-the-docs. Writes one site directory with the Publisher's output at publisher/ and the AST's resources at ast-data/, for gh-pages only.

install.cli: bash src/tools/mount_platform.sh; java 17+, maven, npm install -g fsh-sushi@3.20.1, BUNDLE_GEMFILE=cat-harness/docs/Gemfile bundle install
